name: v26.11.0
body:
## What's Changed
* fix: pin Python to 3.13 to avoid Ansible compatibility issues with… by @shvenkat-rh in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5224
* Amazon Linux 2027 is in Preview by @OurFriendIrony in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5208
* fix: resolve collection playbooks with extensions by @jhang01 in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5191
* fix: preserve explicit YAML tags like !!python/name during --fix by @Ishita-Singh-12 in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5202
* fix: do not color stderr output when stderr is redirected by @Ishita-Singh-12 in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5203
* Combine cache exclusion, YAML formatting, and event-query fixes by @shvenkat-rh in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5228
* perf: avoid deepcopy in _sanitize_task by @simonpahl in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5207
* fix(security): update dependencies to resolve Dependabot alerts by @sudhirverma in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5230

## New Contributors
* @OurFriendIrony made their first contribution in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5208
* @jhang01 made their first contribution in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5191
* @Ishita-Singh-12 made their first contribution in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5202
* @simonpahl made their first contribution in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5207

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/compare/v26.10.1...v26.11.0
